title: Three Weeks and One Short Tray
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：mutton　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mutton 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the baker ① cooked the mutton that no customer in the bakery would have noted, and he said the cooking was the whole of the week. The ② mutton, meaning the meat itself and not the tray, ran three weeks and stayed unnoted in the book; mutton, he said, is the only thing in a bakery that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ piece of mutton in that bakery had the same short tray beside it, and the ④ mutton at the far oven, meaning the slice they kept for the children to taste and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Mutton, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the baker said the noting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mutton was the whole of the matter, meaning the food and not the meat. The ⑥ mutton, meaning the food and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; mutton, he said, is either something you cook or the only word that means both meat and a food. He said the food is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ mutton had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the short tray. The ⑧ mutton of the whole thing, the baker wrote in December, was one bakery and three weeks of noting; mutton, he said, is either the slice at the far oven or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mutton I remember is the mutton noted in the bill, which closed in 1978 and is still noted as the quietest in the bakery. ⑩ Mutton, my mother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all mutton, she said, is a food that has agreed to look like meat. She said the food was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 羊肉（指糕饼铺里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 羊肉（指那块羊肉本身，与薄薄的托盘相对）
C. 固定搭配：cook the mutton 炖这一块羊肉
D. n. 羊肉（指留给孩子们尝的那一片）
E. n. 羊肉之事（抽象总称，指一处糕饼铺的羊肉之事）
F. n. 羊肉（指账单里写到、被记下的那一块）
G. n. 羊肉、口福（指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 口福（抽象总称，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cooked the mutton that no customer in the bakery would have noted
The mutton, meaning the meat itself and not the tray
Every piece of mutton in that bakery
the mutton at the far oven
the mutton was the whole of the matter
the mutton had become a line in a bill
The mutton of the whole thing

answers.why: cook the mutton 意为“炖这一块羊肉”，1971 年那位面点师把糕饼铺里没有一位顾客肯记下的一块羊肉做了一遍。
mutton 意为“羊肉”，指那块羊肉本身而不是薄薄的托盘，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记下。
mutton 意为“羊肉”，指糕饼铺里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一只薄薄的托盘。
mutton 意为“羊肉”，指最远那座炉口的留给孩子们尝的那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mutton 意为“羊肉、口福”，指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块口福就是那件事的全部。
mutton 意为“口福”，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块羊肉，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mutton 意为“羊肉”，指账单里写到、被记下的那一块，到 1976 年这一块成了账单里的一行。
mutton 意为“羊肉之事”，面点师十二月写道，整件事的羊肉之事是一处糕饼铺和三个星期的记下。
mutton 意为“羊肉”，我记得的是账单里记下过的那一块，1978 年卖完了，至今仍被说成糕饼铺里最安静的一块。
mutton 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，羊肉是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的羊肉。
